data.name: Rayaan
data.gender_notes: Rayaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rayaan is an Arabic name that refers to a lush, green, and flourishing garden. It symbolizes growth, abundance, and beauty. The name Rayaan carries the meaning “Watered, Luxuriant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rayaan usually hope their child will grow to embody watered, luxuriant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rayaan is associated with Paradise, where believers will dwell in eternal gardens of bliss.
data.etymology: Rayaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Watered, Luxuriant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayaan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: ریعان
